tagline: A daily gel cleanser that removes environmental buildup and impurities while helping preserve the skin’s comfort.
description: Designed for everyday use, RESET CLEANSER helps wash away daily impurities and environmental buildup while preserving the skin barrier. Its gentle, pollution-lifting gel formula leaves skin feeling clean, balanced and refreshed without unnecessarily stripping the skin.
image_alt: EMBRAE Reset Cleanser, 100 ml gel cleanser with pump
benefits: Cleanses without unnecessarily stripping the skin
Leaves skin feeling clean, balanced and refreshed
routine_text: Follow with Defend, Adapt and Protect.

howto.title: Massage
howto.text: Massage gently over damp face and neck for 30–60 seconds, avoiding the eye area.

inci: Aqua, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Glycerin, Decyl Glucoside, Coco-Glucoside, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Hydroxyethyl Urea, Anhydroxylitol, Xylitol, Xylitylglucoside, Betaine, Sodium Hyaluronate, Niacinamide, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Panthenol, Inulin, Beta-Glucan, Sodium Hydroxide, Ectoin, Allantoin, Ceramide NP, Copolymer.
storage:
Storage instructions
Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Protect from direct sunlight and excessive heat.

Caution
Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water.

Note
Perform a patch test before use. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

For external use only.
